summary: Full backend + frontend testing of private SpotYou visibility rules. Backend: 14/14 tests pass. Frontend: 6/7 scenarios pass (1 skipped — no seed member for pt_e8e4497fed69). All core features verified: home feed returns visibility_type, search returns private SpotYou, non-member sees private banner + invitation-only button, owner sees no banner, private badge 'Privé' visible in listings, POST /join returns 403 for private SpotYou.

issues: Private banner has very low background opacity (#6366F108 ≈ 4% opacity) which may not provide enough visual contrast. The text is indigo on near-transparent background — consider slightly higher opacity like #6366F120.

critical_code_review_comments: invitation-only-btn is a View (not TouchableOpacity) — correct design: non-interactive, no click handler. Style joinBtnInviteOnly uses #6366F110 (transparent indigo) to differentiate from the clickable join button.

Home feed carousel ('Pour vous' section) does NOT use SpotYouCard testIDs for the badge — the carousel component uses a different renderer. Only 'Derniers ajouts' (bottom section using SpotYouCard) has the testID badge. This is by design — no issue.

Test #5 (member scenario) cannot be verified: no non-owner accepted member exists for pt_e8e4497fed69 in seed data. Code logic is correct (condition: !isMember → if isMember=true, banner/invite-btn hidden, normal Quitter btn shown).
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. pt_e8e4497fed69 has only 1 member (the owner coach@winek.app). To test member scenario (#5), a test user needs to be invited/accepted as member.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Private SpotYou visibility feature fully tested and working. Key points: (1) home feed uses key 'spotyou' (not 'spot_you') in JSON response; (2) invitation-only-btn is a View not a button (non-interactive by design); (3) home feed carousel items don't use SpotYouCard testIDs — only 'Derniers ajouts' section uses SpotYouCard with badge testID; (4) all login form interactions use data-testid='login-btn' and must be clicked via JS (not keyboard); (5) member scenario for pt_e8e4497fed69 not testable — only owner is a member.
